Hannah: Quick postmortem follow-up for INC-2026-081  need to lock owners for long-tail signal curation, threshold retunes, dedupe candidates, and paging policy changes. Opening thread for action items.
OpsReminderBot: Incident INC-2026-081 resolved by autoscale at 2026-03-29T11:42:00Z. Postmortem: /incidents/INC-2026-081.
Diego: I'll own long-tail signal curation + recurrence detection prototype. Plan: run a 60d recurrence analysis and flag alerts with >4 repeats/week. ETA: Fri EOD.
Mira: I'll take thresholds and the canary dashboard. Will compute rolling p95/p99 and spike windows for inference.* metrics tomorrow morning.
Hannah: Paging/rota? We want to reduce wake-ups overnight and coalesce repeaters. Suggest: create "low-touch" route 23:00-07:00 and a 12m suppression window for repeated identical alerts.
Diego: Draft recurrence rule (dry-run): `if occurrences(alert_key, 30d) >= 6 and pattern_score > 0.55 then mark "recurring"`  will post candidate list.
Mira: Threshold idea: move noisy-signal alerts to higher thresholds where p99 >> baseline. Also attach a 24h canary with rollback if noise increases. I'll post SQL + graphs by 09:00 PT.
Hannah: Owners summary so far: recurrence/curation = Diego, thresholds + canary = Mira, paging/rota = Hannah. Target: PRs + runbook snippets open by 2026-04-02. Tag PRs `postmortem/INC-2026-081`.
Diego: I'll run a dry-run and post a CSV of suppressed candidates. Expect ~12 candidates/day if we suppress naive rules.
Mira: Adding rollback automation: if alert volume up >10% post-change in 24h, auto-revert thresholds or routing. Will add tests to the canary job.
Hannah: Sequence: 1) Diego: recurrence analysis + candidate list (Fri EOD) 2) Mira: thresholds + 24h canary dashboards (tomorrow 09:00 PT) 3) Hannah: paging config + low-touch route PR (Mon) 4) Hannah: consolidate follow-up doc + schedule 15m sync after rollout.
Diego: Draft branch `recurrence-curation-81` created, running backtest now.
Mira: 44d SQLs and charts will be in the PR description.
Hannah: React with :white_check_mark: when PRs are up. If anyone hits perms/data blockers, call it out here.
OpsReminderBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-sync (INC-2026-081) on 2026-04-03T16:00:00Z.
